mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which increase risperidone's risk of QT prolongation and orthostatic hypotension; additive hypotensive effects and potential for hyponatremia-induced hyponatremic encephalopathy.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly, blood pressure, and ECG; consider alternative antihypertensive if possible or adjust dosing; educate patient on orthostatic precautions.
